XG - Head In The Clouds Los Angeles 2026 [2026.8.8] (1080p HD)​


​
XG took the stage at 88rising’s Head in the Clouds Music & Arts Festival on Saturday, August 8, 2026, at Brookside at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California, as part of their ongoing XG WORLD TOUR: THE CORE. The group joined a stacked lineup featuring co-headliners KATSEYE, as well as Rich Brian, Dabin.kr, UMI, KiiiKiii, Warren Hue, and more, bringing together a diverse mix of artists from across the Asian and global music scenes.
